mappings.source: LSJ s.v. χαίνω redirects to χάσκω; χάσκω includes the Acharnians 10 form.
mappings.counterexample: Does not establish that a supplied token is a form of this verb.

mappings.source: LSJ s.v. τρεῖς includes neuter τρία within the same numeral entry.
mappings.counterexample: Does not merge τριάς or another numeral.

mappings.source: LSJ s.v. μοχθηρός records the accentuation dispute; this policy adopts its entry heading, without denying the variant tradition.
mappings.counterexample: Does not license a general shift of adjective accents.

mappings.source: LSJ s.v. κάνεον lists Attic contracted κανοῦν. Apply to a selected nominal proposal, not the competing verb καίνω.
mappings.counterexample: A verbal proposal or unknown POS abstains; the mapping does not select a noun over a verb.

mappings.source: Owner-approved example, 2026-11-08: preserve the separate Diogenes/LSJ aorist heading. The current form must have a verified Morpheus association with that entry. This is a translation of provider grouping, not a global equivalence of the two LSJ entries.
mappings.counterexample: Present προσλέγω, unrelated meanings, or a form without the required Morpheus association retain their own headword.
